capabilities: Writes questions from your notes and grades typed answers with partial credit
Schedules concept reviews with FSRS, including exam dates
Runs an agentic chat that reads, searches, edits and creates vault notes
Keeps a record of confusions and past answers that other agents can read
Plays existing Spaced Repetition and Anki cloze cards without AI
extras: Freemium: Grill Cloud gives free credits, then $7.99/month plus credit packs. On Grill Cloud, notes and answers pass through the author's server to Anthropic (not stored, kept by Anthropic up to 30 days); other options send notes directly to the chosen provider. Detailed docs live in external files (docs/features.md, privacy, cloud, models, troubleshooting).
motivation: The author takes many notes to learn new material and needed a way to learn them more deeply.
problem: Obsidian stores what you write but has no built-in way to quiz yourself on it, grade answers, or track what you keep getting wrong.
